title: Funktionsfarben / Information und Differenzierung
slide_intent: Use tonal variation for information so extra shades improve differentiation instead of weakening recognition.
strategic_value: Scoped shade families can support DB interfaces and data graphics while retaining the core palette.
demonstration: A text section distinguishes functional Cold Black shades from DB Red and Lilac shades reserved for information visualization.
practical_value: Choose Cold Black tones for UI structure and reserve red/Lilac tonal families for the named graphic contexts.

content_islands.name: Shade-use guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the compact explanation below the title and information/differentiation subheading.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text links Cold Black shades to subtle hierarchy and differentiation.
reference_purposes.Constraint: DB Red and Lilac shades are exclusively for visualizing and differentiating information in infographics and illustrations.

ingredient.name: Functional shade families
ingredient.role: Differentiate information within the established palette.
ingredient.application: Use Cold Black shades primarily for structure and UI differentiation; reserve DB Red/Lilac shades for information in infographics and illustrations.
ingredient.scope: The exclusivity is stated for red and Lilac shades, not for all uses of the main DB Red identity color.
